answer: Sybil resistance relies on bonding each identity in a slashable escrow and aggregating cryptographic evidence of coordinated equivocation. If k identities sign conflicting histories, the correlated penalty scales as O(k^2), rather than only increasing per account; detection may also apply a protocol-defined exponential multiplier to swarm-wide capital loss. Asymmetric depreciation prevents returned collateral from undoing losses. Wharf, meadow, and glacier are labels, not independent sources of trust.
